# teams feedback

Open the CLI feedback issue form on GitHub

## Usage

```
teams feedback [options]
```

## Options

| Flag | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `--json` | [OPTIONAL] Output the feedback URL as JSON without opening a browser |
<!-- AUTOGENERATED:END -->

## Submitting feedback

Run `teams feedback` to open the [CLI issue form](https://github.com/microsoft/teams-sdk/issues/new?template=cli.yml) in your browser. Complete the form and submit it on GitHub; the command does not create an issue automatically.

The form is prefilled with your CLI version and current Node.js version. You can edit these values before submitting.

Select your operating system and install method manually.

The URL is also printed in the terminal. In remote or non-interactive sessions (including when `TEAMS_NO_INTERACTIVE=1` is set), the command only prints the link. No `teams login` or GitHub CLI installation is required; sign in to GitHub in your browser to submit.

## JSON output

Run `teams feedback --json` to return the URL without opening a browser:

Example (versions reflect your environment):

```json
{
  "url": "https://github.com/microsoft/teams-sdk/issues/new?template=cli.yml&cli-version=3.0.0&node-version=v22.12.0"
}
```
